meta.title: Open Planner Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Free, open-source construction scheduling: Gantt, critical path, resources and reports. Opens MS Project (.mpp) and Primavera P6 (.xer) files, saves as open IFC 4.3. Windows, macOS, Linux and web.

header.label: Construction scheduling
header.title: Open Planner Studio
header.tagline: Free construction scheduling that opens your MS Project and P6 files
header.desc: Gantt, critical path and resources, saved as an open IFC file. On your computer or straight in the browser.
header.heroAlt: Open Planner Studio: Gantt schedule of six terraced houses with task table, bars, relations and properties panel

testers.text: Testers wanted: planners, site engineers, project leads and BIM coordinators.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything a construction planner needs
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.

cpm.title: See what drives your end date
cpm.desc: The app calculates the critical path, float and near-critical work. You see multiple critical paths and missed deadlines straight away in the Gantt.
cpm.alt: Gantt with red critical-path bars and relation lines between tasks

files.title: Open your MS Project and Primavera P6 files
files.desc: Open .mpp and .xer files directly, without the original program. Across 216 .mpp test files the dates match to the minute. Dates as recorded shows the dates the other program stored itself.
files.alt: Imported MS Project file with split bars and the critical path

table.title: Edit your schedule like a spreadsheet
table.desc: One task table beside the Gantt and as a full view. Paste whole blocks from Excel, edit dependencies in the cell and choose days or hours per task.
table.alt: Full table view with WBS, task names, duration, dates and work category

crews.title: Stop double-booking your crews
crews.desc: Share one resource library across all your projects. The occupancy overview adds up every open project and marks the days where demand exceeds capacity.
crews.alt: Occupancy overview with double-booked days per resource and a histogram

reports.title: Reports ready to send
reports.desc: Choose from eleven reports, from the Gantt print to a look-ahead and the DCMA 14-point assessment. You get a live print preview and a PDF on A4 up to A1.
reports.alt: Report window with settings and a print preview of the Gantt

ifc.title: Your schedule is an open IFC file
ifc.desc: Open Planner Studio saves in IFC 4.3, the open buildingSMART standard. There is no closed format, and BIM software can place your schedule beside the building model for 4D analysis.
ifc.alt: Excerpt of a schedule as an IFC 4.3 file with tasks, task times and relations

gantt.title: Gantt chart
gantt.desc: Drag bars, draw relations with the mouse and zoom from the whole project down to the hour.

cpm.title: Critical path
cpm.desc: Float, near-critical work and multiple critical paths, with constraints and deadlines.

wbs.title: WBS and task table
wbs.desc: A collapsible task structure with WBS templates and your own work categories. You edit everything as in a spreadsheet.

profiles.title: Calculation profiles
profiles.desc: Calculate like Primavera P6, like Microsoft Project or with the app's own profile. For each rule you see what the profile does.

calendars.title: Calendars and hour planning
calendars.desc: Public holidays, the construction holiday and your own working times per calendar. Plan each task in days or in hours.

split.title: Splitting tasks
split.desc: Cut a bar at a date and drag the pieces apart. Remove an interruption again from the context menu.

progress.title: Baselines and progress
progress.desc: Save several baselines and update progress with a status date and a progress line.

progresssheet.title: Progress through a spreadsheet
progresssheet.desc: Export a progress sheet as Excel or CSV, have it filled in and read it back. Beforehand you see exactly what will change.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.desc: Save a view with its filter, grouping, columns and time scale as a button in the ribbon.

warnings.title: Warnings panel
warnings.desc: A list of the rules your schedule breaks. One click takes you to the task, relation or resource.

resources.title: Resources and leveling
resources.desc: Labour, equipment and subcontractors with a histogram. Level overallocation automatically, and see per day why someone is overbooked.

workrules.title: Task types
workrules.desc: Choose fixed duration, fixed work or fixed units per task. The task type decides what follows when you change the duration or the effort.

library.title: Resource library
library.desc: Share one resource pool across several projects and manage it in one place. Differences in a project are flagged.

occupancy.title: Occupancy overview
occupancy.desc: Add up the load across all your open projects and see on which days a resource is double-booked.

contours.title: Hour distribution
contours.desc: Spread the work of an assignment over its duration with a curve, or adjust the distribution yourself.

mpp.title: MS Project (.mpp)
mpp.desc: Open .mpp files from MS Project 2010 through 2021 directly, without Microsoft Project.

xer.title: Primavera P6 (.xer and XML)
xer.desc: Open P6 files with WBS, calendars, resources and progress. A file with several projects opens one tab per project.

exchange.title: Import and export
exchange.desc: Export to MS Project XML, Primavera P6 XML, CSV and IFC. The app tells you per format what does not go along.

ifc.title: IFC 4.3, ready for 4D
ifc.desc: Your schedule is an IFC file. Choose IFC 4.3 or IFC4 when saving, so BIM software can merge it with your model.

ai.title: AI assistant (optional)
ai.desc: Connect an AI assistant such as Claude Code in the desktop app. You stay in control with a read-only mode, backups and an activity log.

reporttypes.title: Eleven report types
reporttypes.desc: Gantt print, resource diagram, milestones, variance, look-ahead, progress, critical path and more, with a shared reporting period.

dcma.title: DCMA 14-point assessment
dcma.desc: The Schedule health report starts with the DCMA 14-point assessment. A flag is a reason to look further, not a failure.

resdiagram.title: Resource diagram
resdiagram.desc: The Gantt per resource, one sheet per person, with the load per week or per month.

print.title: Print preview and PDF
print.desc: Live print preview and PDF on A4, A3, A2 or A1, with baseline and a status or progress line.

platforms.title: Desktop and browser
platforms.desc: Install on Windows, macOS or Linux, or work straight in the browser, including open and save.

autosave.title: AutoSave and recovery
autosave.desc: Let the app save your file regularly. Separately, crash recovery keeps your work if something goes wrong.

help.title: Help in the app
help.desc: Press F1 for 78 articles. The question mark in a window opens the matching article straight away.

languages.title: 28 languages
languages.desc: The interface and the Help come in 28 languages, including right-to-left Arabic and Persian.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts and context menus
shortcuts.desc: All shortcuts on one screen with Ctrl+/, and a right-click menu on row, bar and timeline.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download v2026.10.0
download.lead: Free, no account needed. The desktop app tells you itself when a new version is out.
download.browserNote: Rather not install anything? The app also runs fully in the browser, including open and save.
download.mobileNote: Open Planner Studio is made for a large screen. Open it on your computer, or try it here in the browser.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.10.0
whatsnew.title: Primavera P6, calculation profiles and 28 languages
whatsnew.desc: A large release. The main points are listed here. The app also writes IFC 4.3 ADD2 by default, hours read 10h everywhere, and the feedback button sends your report directly to Open Feedback Studio, an external OpenAEC service, without a GitHub account. The full list is in the changelog.

xer.title: Open Primavera P6 (.xer)
xer.desc: With WBS, calendars, resources and progress. The original file travels inside your IFC.

profiles.title: Calculation profiles
profiles.desc: Calculate like P6, MS Project or Open Planner Studio, and see the difference per rule.

work.title: Task type per task and task splitting
work.desc: Choose fixed duration, units or work per task. The old Task type field is now called Work category. In the Gantt you cut a bar at a date.

progress.title: Progress through a spreadsheet
progress.desc: Export a sheet as .xlsx or CSV, have it filled in and read it back with a preview.

reports.title: Seven new reports
reports.desc: Including the DCMA 14-point assessment, plus a resource diagram per person.

languages.title: 28 languages and a new Help
languages.desc: Interface and Help in 28 languages. The Help was rewritten into 78 articles.

import.q: Can I open files from Microsoft Project or Primavera P6?
import.a: Yes. The app opens .mpp files (MS Project 2010 through 2021) and Primavera P6 .xer files directly, without the original program. MS Project XML, Primavera P6 XML, CSV and IFC can be opened and exported. The app never changes an .mpp or .xer: you save as IFC.

profiles.q: Does it calculate like P6 or MS Project?
profiles.a: You choose that with the calculation profile: Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or Open Planner Studio. An .xer opens with the P6 profile and an .mpp with the MS Project profile. Dates as recorded also shows the dates the other program calculated itself.

browser.q: Do I have to install anything?
browser.a: No. The whole app runs in the browser, with open, save, AutoSave and crash recovery. In Chrome and Edge, Ctrl+S saves back to the same file; in Firefox and Safari you pick a file when saving. If you do want to install, there are versions for Windows, macOS and Linux.

prijs.q: What does Open Planner Studio cost?
prijs.a: Nothing. The app is free and open source under the LGPL-3.0 licence. No subscription and no per-user licence fees.

formaat.q: What file format is my schedule saved in?
formaat.a: In IFC 4.3, the open buildingSMART standard. Your schedule is an IFC file; there is no proprietary, closed format. Your data stays readable outside this app, and BIM software can place your schedule beside a building model for 4D analysis.

platforms.q: Which systems does it run on?
platforms.a: Windows (.exe), macOS (universal .dmg, for Intel and Apple Silicon) and Linux (.deb, .rpm, AppImage and snap). Plus fully in the browser.

bouwpraktijk.a: Yes. You build calendars with public holidays, the construction holiday and your own working times, and plan each task in days or in hours. Resources can be labour, equipment, material or subcontractors, and the reports are made for site meetings and clients.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with my schedule?
ai.a: It is optional and off by default. Switch on AI mode in the desktop app and an AI client such as Claude Code can read and edit your open schedule. You stay in control: there is a pause button, a read-only mode, an automatic backup before the first change and a log of every call.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A thin native shell in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux. The same app also runs as a web build.

engine.title: Calculation engine in TypeScript
engine.desc: CPM, calendars, leveling and calculation profiles run in the browser and in the desktop app.

react.title: React 19 + TypeScript
react.desc: The interface, with Zustand and Immer for state and undo. Built with Vite and Tailwind CSS.

canvas.title: HTML5 Canvas 2D
canvas.desc: The Gantt timeline is drawn on a canvas; the same drawing routine produces the print and the PDF.

ifc.title: IFC 4.3 ADD2
ifc.desc: The native file format, written schema-valid; IFC4 is also possible. In the browser the app uses the File System Access API where available.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.desc: In the desktop app a built-in MCP server offers planner_* tools to an AI client.
